def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive access to observation fields
    my_position = observation.get('player_position', [0, 0])
    grid_width = observation.get('grid_width', 1)
    grid_height = observation.get('grid_height', 1)
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    opponents = observation.get('opponents', [])
    evader_positions = observation.get('evader_positions', [])
    territory_control = observation.get('territory_control', [])
    # Default vectors
    dx, dy = 0, 0
    px, py = my_position
    # Resource collection: move towards the closest resource
    if resources:
        closest_resource = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0]-px)+abs(r[1]-py))
        delta_x = closest_resource[0] - px
        delta_y = closest_resource[1] - py
        if abs(delta_x) > abs(delta_y):
            dx = 1 if delta_x > 0 else -1
        elif abs(delta_y) > 0:
            dy = 1 if delta_y > 0 else -1
    # Pursuit evasion: if opponent nearby, move away
    elif opponents:
        for opp in opponents:
            ox, oy = opp
            if abs(ox - px) + abs(oy - py) <= 3:
                # move away from opponent
                dx = -1 if ox > px else (1 if ox < px else 0)
                dy = -1 if oy > py else (1 if oy < py else 0)
                break
        else:
            dx, dy = 0, 0
    # Territory control: move towards nearest high-value region
    elif territory_control:
        # pick the region with highest value
        max_value = -float('inf')
        target_region = None
        for region in territory_control:
            rx, ry, value = region
            if value > max_value:
                max_value = value
                target_region = (rx, ry)
        if target_region:
            delta_x = target_region[0] - px
            delta_y = target_region[1] - py
            if abs(delta_x) > abs(delta_y):
                dx = 1 if delta_x > 0 else -1
            elif abs(delta_y) > 0:
                dy = 1 if delta_y > 0 else -1
    return [dx, dy]
